title: Musk says any limits on Ukraine's Starlink access down to US, not his firm
english: Elon Musk has stated that the US government, rather than his company, is responsible for setting speed and usage restrictions on Starlink and Starshield services in Ukraine. Recent connectivity issues impacted Ukrainian drone operations, prompting calls from Kyiv for immediate restoration of full service. Musk clarified that his company provides civilian internet but relies on US military authorization for military-grade network operations.
amharic: ኢሎን ማስክ በዩክሬን ውስጥ የሚገኙት የስታርሊንክ እና የስታርሺልድ አገልግሎቶች ፍጥነትና የአጠቃቀም ገደቦች የተጣሉት በኩባንያው ሳይሆን በአሜሪካ መንግሥት እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። በቅርቡ የተከሰተው የግንኙነት መቋረጥ የዩክሬን የድሮን እንቅስቃሴዎችን በመጉዳቱ፣ ኪየቭ አገልግሎቱ ሙሉ በሙሉ እንዲመለስ ጥያቄ አቅርባለች። ማስክ አክለውም፣ ኩባንያቸው ሲቪል የኢንተርኔት አገልግሎት እንደሚሰጥ ነገር ግን ወታደራዊ አገልግሎቶቹ በአሜሪካ ጦር ቁጥጥር ሥር መሆናቸውን አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Elon Musk tajaajilli Starlink fi Starshield biyya Yukreen keessatti daangeeffame murtee mootummaa Ameerikaa malee murtee dhaabbata isaa miti jedheera. Rakkoon quunnamtii dhiheenya kana mudate hojii dooniiwwan Yukreen irratti dhiibbaa waan uumeef, mootummaan Yukreen tajaajilichi akka guutummaatti deebi'u gaafatteetti. Musk ibsa isaan, dhaabbatichi tajaajila interneetii siivilii kan kennu yoo ta'u, hojiiwwan waraanaa garuu harka fi ajaja waraana Ameerikaa jala akka jiran beeksisaniiru.

title: Student protesters attack government buildings in Albania
english: Thousands of students in Tirana, Albania, have engaged in violent anti-government protests, leading to attacks on several public buildings, including the Ministry of Education. Demonstrators are demanding improvements to university conditions and broader systemic change, citing high levels of government corruption and economic frustration. While authorities have deployed riot police to disperse the crowds with tear gas and water cannons, the opposition party has expressed support for the protesters' actions.

oromo: Magaalaa guddoo Albaniyaa Tiraanaatti barattoonni kumaan lakkaa'aman mormii mootummaa irratti qaban guyyaa lammaffaaf gaggeessaa jiru. Barattoonni kun haala barnootaa fooyyessuu fi malaammaltummaa mootummaa irratti mormii guddaa kaasaniiru; kana keessas manneen hojii mootummaa irratti miidhaa geessisaniiru. Poolisiin mormitoota bittinneessuuf gaazii imimmaansisuu fi bishaan humnaan gadi lakkisuu fayyadameera; mootummaan immoo gocha kana balaaleffateera.

title: Denmark pushes back as Trump touts Greenland oil and mineral deals
english: Denmark has clarified that a recent agreement with the United States and Greenland does not grant American companies special rights to extract natural resources. This response follows claims by President Trump suggesting that large-scale mining and drilling projects are about to commence on the island. Danish officials emphasized that the current deal focuses on military cooperation and defense, while strictly upholding Greenland’s sovereignty and existing environmental laws.
amharic: ዴንማርክ ከአሜሪካ እና ከግሪንላንድ ጋር የተፈራረመችው የቅርብ ጊዜ ስምምነት የአሜሪካ ኩባንያዎች የተፈጥሮ ሃብቶችን ለመዝረፍ ልዩ መብት እንደማይሰጥ አስታውቃለች። ይህ መግለጫ የወጣው በግሪንላንድ ግዙፍ የማዕድን እና የነዳጅ ማውጣት ስራዎች በቅርቡ ይጀመራሉ በማለት ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በሰጡት መግለጫ ነው። የዴንማርክ ባለስልጣናት ስምምነቱ በዋናነት በወታደራዊ ትብብር ላይ ያተኮረ እንጂ፣ የግሪንላንድን ሉዓላዊነት እና የሃገር ውስጥ ህጎችን የሚጥስ አለመሆኑን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Denmaarkiin waliigaltee dhihoo kana Ameerikaa fi Gireenlaandii waliin mallatteessiteen, kampaniin Ameerikaa qabeenya uumamaa lafaa sanaa fayyadamuuf mirga addaa akka hin qabne ibsiteerti. Ibsi kun kan dhufe erga pirezidaant Traamp Gireenlaanditti hojiin albuudaa fi boba'aa baasuu dafee akka jalqabu dubbatanii boodadha. Hojiin mootummaan Denmaark akka ibsetti, waliigalteen kun kan xiyyeeffatu walta'iinsa waraanaa irratti malee, birmadummaa Gireenlaandii fi seera naannichaas kan hin cabsine ta'uu mirkaneessaniiru.

title: ICE pushes back on report suggesting body cameras that automatically record
english: The U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agency has formally rejected a recommendation from government auditors to implement body cameras that record automatically. While the Government Accountability Office suggested this technology to ensure transparency during unpredictable encounters, ICE officials cited privacy concerns as their primary reason for the refusal. This decision comes amidst increasing public scrutiny regarding the use of force by immigration agents during enforcement operations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የኢሚግሬሽን እና የጉምሩክ ማስፈጸሚያ ኤጀንሲ (ICE)፣ የመንግስት ኦዲተሮች በድንገተኛ ሁኔታዎች በራስ-ሰር የሚቀዱ የሰውነት ካሜራዎችን እንዲጠቀሙ ያቀረቡትን ሃሳብ ውድቅ አድርጓል። የመንግስት ተጠያቂነት ቢሮ ይህ ቴክኖሎጂ ግልጽነትን ለማስፈን እንደሚረዳ ቢጠቁምም፣ ኤጀንሲው የግለሰቦች የደህንነት ስጋት በመኖሩ ምክንያት ሀሳቡን አልቀበልም ብሏል። ይህ ውሳኔ ኤጀንሲው በስራው ወቅት ኃይልን ስለመጠንቀቁ እና ስለሚጠቀምባቸው ድርጊቶች እየተነሳ ባለው ከፍተኛ የህዝብ ተቃውሞ መካከል የተወሰነ ነው።
oromo: Ejensiin Immigiresinii fi Gumurukii Amerikaa (ICE), gorsa qorattoonni mootummaa kaameraa qaamaa ofumaan sagalee fi suuraa kaasu fayyadamuuf dhiyeessan fudhachuu dideera. Waajjirri Itti Gaafatamummaa Mootummaa tekinolojiin kun yeroo haalli hin eegamne uumamutti iftoomina akka mirkaneessu ibsuus, ICE garuu dhimmi iccitii fi mirga dhunfaa sababoota ijoo ta'uun gorsa kana mormeera. Murteen kun kan dhufu, hojjettoonni immigiresinii kun hojii isaanii irratti humnaa fi tarkaanfii fudhataniin walqabatee komii fi mormii ummataa cimaa jiru gidduutti dha.

title: Real Madrid come from 3-1 down to beat Roma on Champions League travels
english: Real Madrid achieved a dramatic 4-3 comeback victory against Roma in their recent Champions League match. Despite trailing 3-1 late in the second half, the visitors scored three goals in seven minutes from corner kicks to secure the win. This result provides significant relief for Real Madrid manager Jose Mourinho, who was returning to face his former club.

Gareen kun walakkaa lammaffaa irratti 3-1 waan tureef, daqiiqaa torba keessatti kubbaa koornara irraa goolii sadii galchuun injifannoo argachuu danda'eera. Injifannoon kun leenjisaa Ri'aal Maadriid Josee Moriniihoo kan garee isaa duraanii irratti dhiyaatan irratti dhiibbaa ture salphiseera.

title: PSG beat Man City 4-2 in Champions League thriller
english: Paris Saint-Germain defeated Manchester City 4-2 in an exciting Champions League match held at the Etihad Stadium. PSG dominated the first half with three quick goals, and despite two goals from Erling Haaland for City, the visitors maintained their lead to secure the win. The match took place amidst ongoing pressure on Manchester City following recent rulings regarding their financial conduct.
amharic: ፓሪስ ሴንት ጀርመን በቻምፒዮንስ ሊግ ጨዋታ ማንችስተር ሲቲን 4 ለ 2 በሆነ ውጤት አሸንፏል። የፈረንሳዩ ክለብ በጨዋታው የመጀመሪያ አጋማሽ ባስቆጠራቸው ሶስት ግቦች የበላይነቱን የወሰደ ሲሆን፣ ኤርሊንግ ሃላንድ ለማንችስተር ሲቲ ሁለት ግቦችን ቢያስቆጥርም የፓሪስ ሴንት ጀርመንን ድል ማስቀረት አልቻለም። ይህ ጨዋታ የተካሄደው ማንችስተር ሲቲ በገንዘብ ነክ ህግ ጥሰት ክስ በተመሰረተበት ወቅት ነው።

Paaris Saint-Jarmaan walakkaa jalqabaa taphichaa goolii sadii galchuun dursuun isaa kan yaadatamu yoo ta'u, Erliing Haalaand Maanchistar Siitiif goolii lama galchulleen injifannoo Paaris Saint-Jarmaan dhaabsisuu hin dandeenye. Taphi kun kan taasifame yeroo Maanchistar Siitiin himannaa yakka maallaqaa wajjiin walqabatu keessa jiruutti dha.

title: Colombia opposition groups launch protest against de la Espriella’s cuts
english: Thousands of protesters led by former President Gustavo Petro took to the streets in Colombia to oppose the austerity measures and economic policies introduced by President Abelardo de la Espriella. The demonstrators fear that the new administration is dismantling essential social reforms and labour protections established by the previous government. In response to the protests, the government has authorized police to use stricter measures to prevent vandalism or the blockage of public services.
amharic: የቀድሞው ፕሬዝዳንት ጉስታቮ ፔትሮ የሚመሩት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተቃዋሚዎች በፕሬዝዳንት አቤላርዶ ደ ላ እስፕሪዬላ በመንግስት ወጪ ቅነሳ እና በኢኮኖሚ ፖሊሲዎች ላይ ተቃውሞአቸውን አሰምተዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ አዲሱ አስተዳደር የቀድሞው መንግስት የጀመራቸውን የማህበራዊ እና የሰራተኛ መብት ማሻሻያዎችን እየቀለበሰ ነው ብለው ያምናሉ። መንግስት በበኩሉ ሰላማዊ ሰልፉን ሰበብ በማድረግ የህዝብ አገልግሎትን ለሚረብሹ ወይም ንብረት ለሚያወድሙ አካላት ላይ ጠንካራ የፖሊስ እርምጃ እንደሚወስድ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Hiriirri mormii pirezidaantii duraanii Gustaavoo Pirootroon durfamu, tarkaanfii dinagdee pirezidaantii ammaa Aabelaardoo de la Espireellaa mormuuf Kolombiyaatti geggeeffameera. Mormitoonni mootummaan ammaa kun jijjiiramoota hawaasummaa fi mirga hojjattootaa kanneen mootummaan darbe hojiirra oolchee ture diigaa jiraachuu isaatti yaadda'u. Mootummaan gamasaatiin, mormiin kun yoo qabeenya barbadeesse ykn tajaajila hawaasaa kan gufachiise ta'e, poolisiin tarkaanfii cimaa akka fudhatu ajajeera.

title: Overthrowing Iran's government 'essential for Israel's security', Netanyahu says
english: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu asserts that removing the current Iranian government is vital for Israel's safety. While he claims Israeli actions have significantly weakened Iran and halted their nuclear progress, he admits that a regime change is unlikely before the upcoming October elections. Additionally, Netanyahu criticized his political opponents for not supporting his strategy to dismantle the Iranian leadership.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የኢራን መንግስትን መለወጥ ለእስራኤል ደህንነት ወሳኝ መሆኑን ተናግረዋል። የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች ኢራንን በእጅጉ እንደዳከሟት እና የኑክሌር ፕሮግራሟን እንዳስተጓጎሉ ቢገልጹም፣ በጥቅምት ወር በሚካሄደው ምርጫ በፊት ለውጥ ይመጣል ብለው አያምኑም። በተጨማሪም፣ ኔታንያሁ የኢራን መንግስትን ለማስወገድ የሚሄዱበትን መንገድ የማይደግፉትን ተቀናቃኞቻቸውን ነቅፈዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministiraa Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahu mootummaan Iraan buqqifamuu qabaachuu isaa nageenya Israa'elitti fayyada jechuun ibsan. Tarkaanfiin Israa'el Iraan irratti fudhatte ishee dadhabsiisuu fi qophii niwuukilaraa ishee dhaabuu ishee kan himan ta'us, filannoo guraandhala dhufuun dura jijjiiramni ni dhufa jedhanii hin yaadan. Kana malees, Netanyaahu mormitoonni siyaasaa isaa yaada mootummaa Iraan diiguu kana waan hin deggerreef isaan cee'eera.

title: Houthis claim Saudi military aircraft 'struck directly' over Yemen airspace
english: Houthi forces have announced that they successfully hit a Saudi Arabian Eurofighter Typhoon military jet while it was flying over the Saada region in Yemen. A spokesperson for the group stated that the aircraft was critically damaged by an air-to-air missile and is likely to crash. However, Saudi officials and independent observers have not yet verified these claims or provided details regarding the incident.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን ሳዳ ግዛት ላይ ሲበር የነበረ የሳዑዲ አረቢያ ወታደራዊ ጀት በአየር ላይ መምታታቸውን አስታውቀዋል። የቡድኑ ቃል አቀባይ እንደገለፁት ጄቱ በአየር ላይ በተተኮሰ ሚሳይል ተመትቶ ጉዳት የደረሰበት ሲሆን ሊከሰከሰ እንደሚችል ተናግረዋል። እስካሁን ድረስ የሳዑዲ መንግስትም ሆነ ገለልተኛ አካላት ይህን ጥቃት በይፋ አላረጋገጡም።
oromo: Humni Huthotaa xiyyaarri waraana Saudi Arabiyaa tokko qilleensa naannoo Sa’adaa Yemen irratti balali'aa utuu jiruu rukutamuu isaa ibseera. Dubbi himaan garee kanaa akka jedhetti, xiyyaarichi misaa'elaan rukutamee miidha cimaa irra ga'ee jiraachuu fi kufuuf akka dhiyaate beekameera. Haa ta'u malee, hanga ammaatti mootummaan Saudi Arabiyaa ta'e madda walaba ta'een oduun kun dhugaa ta'uun isaa mirkanaa'uu hin dandeenye.

title: EU calls on Houthis to lift siege on Yemen’s Taiz
english: The European Union has urged Houthi forces to end their blockade of the Yemeni city of Taiz to facilitate the delivery of humanitarian relief. The organization emphasized the need to protect civilians and ensure that essential supplies can reach those in need. This call comes as the World Food Programme reports that residents in the city are facing severe food shortages.
amharic: የአውሮፓ ህብረት የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን ታኢዝ ከተማ ላይ የጣሉትን ከበባ በማንሳት የሰብአዊ እርዳታዎች እንዲገቡ ጥሪ አቅርቧል። ድርጅቱ የሲቪል ሰዎችን ደህንነት መጠበቅ እና አስፈላጊ ቁሳቁሶች ለተቸገሩት መድረስ እንዳለባቸው አሳስቧል። በዓለም የምግብ ፕሮግራም መረጃ መሰረት፣ በከተማዋ ያለው የምግብ እጥረት በጣም አሳሳቢ ደረጃ ላይ ደርሷል።
oromo: Gamtaan Awurooppaa gareen Huutii magaalatti Ta’iz irra kaayee jiru akka kaasuufi gargaarsi namoomaa akka galu gaafateera. Dhaabbatichi lubbuu nagaa eeguufi meeshaaleen barbaachisoon namoota gargaarsa barbaadan bira akka ga’an cimsee hubachiiseera. Dhaabbanni Nyaata Addunyaa akka gabaasetti, magaalattii keessatti hanqinni nyaataa sadarkaa hamaa irra ga’ee jira.

title: Houthi strikes mark the end of Saudi Arabia's Yemen 'containment strategy'
english: Saudi Arabia’s attempt to manage the Houthi movement in Yemen through an uneasy truce has failed, presenting a major challenge for Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman. After years of costly conflict and a subsequent period of passive containment, recent escalations suggest that the kingdom's efforts to keep the group in check have collapsed. Experts compare the Saudi approach to previous failed strategies of containment, noting that the kingdom can no longer rely on the existing status quo to maintain regional stability.
amharic: ሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ በየመን የሚንቀሳቀሱትን ሁቲዎችን በስምምነት ለመገደብ ያደረገችው ጥረት በመከሸፉ ለልዑል አልጋ ወራሽ መሐመድ ቢን ሳልማን ትልቅ ፈተና ሆኗል። ለዓመታት የዘለቀው ውድ ጦርነት እና ቀጥሎም የታየው የዘገየ የመቆጣጠር ስልት አሁን በአዲስ የሁቲዎች ጥቃት መፈራረሱ ተነግሯል። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት ሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ ቀደም ሲል የነበራትን የሁቲዎችን የመቆጣጠር ስልት እንደ ቀድሞው ተግባራዊ ማድረግ አልቻለችም፤ ይህም በክልሉ ያለውን የፀጥታ ሁኔታ አሳሳቢ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Sa’udii Arabiyaan humnoota Huutii Yemen keessa jiran too’achuuf yaalii goote fashaluun isaa angawoota biyyattii keessattuu abbaa taayitaa biyyattii Mohammed bin Salman irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumee jira. Waraana waggoota hedduu fudhate booda, sa’udiin tasgabbii uumuuf yaalii goote hundi amma jeeqama haaraa kanaan gufatee jira. Ogeeyyonni akka jedhanitti, tooftaan Sa’udiin Huutiiwwan ittiin tasgabbeessaa turte amma bu’aa dhabuu isaa fi biyyattiin rakkoo nageenyaa cimaa keessa akka jirtu ibsaniiru.

title: Yemeni army says 200 Houthis killed, wounded in clashes in Taiz
english: The Yemeni military reported that over 200 Houthi fighters were either killed or wounded during intense battles in Taiz province. These confrontations occurred across several fronts, supported by airstrikes that targeted enemy armored vehicles and military positions. The clashes mark a significant escalation in the ongoing regional conflict.
amharic: የየመን ጦር በታይዝ ግዛት በተካሄደው ከፍተኛ ግጭት ከ200 በላይ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች መገደላቸውንና መቁሰላቸውን አስታውቋል። ውጊያው በተለያዩ የጦር ግንባሮች የተካሄደ ሲሆን፣ የአየር ኃይል ድጋፍም በጠላት ተሽከርካሪዎችና በጦር ሰፈሮች ላይ ጥቃት ሰንዝሯል። ይህ ክስተት በአካባቢው እየተካሄደ ያለውን ግጭት አባብሶታል።
oromo: Raayyaan Ittisa biyya Yemen Taiz keessatti waraana cimaa taasifameen lolaan Houthi 200 ol ta'an ajjeefamuu fi madaa'uu ibseera. Loli kun dirree waraanaa garaagaraa irratti kan gaggeeffame yoo ta'u, xiyyaarri waraanaas konkolaataa fi iddoo lolaa isaanii irratti tarkaanfii fudhateera. Taateen kun walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa hammeesseera.

title: Russia attack hits Kyiv after reported intelligence lapse
english: Russian forces launched a significant aerial assault on Kyiv, specifically targeting the city's energy infrastructure. The strikes resulted in power outages for over 500,000 residents. President Zelenskyy noted that Ukraine did not receive any prior intelligence warnings from its allies regarding the impending attack.
amharic: የሩሲያ ኃይሎች በኪየቭ የኃይል ማመንጫ መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይ ያነጣጠረ መጠነ ሰፊ የአየር ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። ጥቃቱ ከግማሽ ሚሊዮን በላይ ለሚሆኑ ነዋሪዎች የኤሌክትሪክ ኃይል መቋረጥ ምክንያት ሆኗል። የዩክሬን ፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ በበኩላቸው፣ ጥቃቱ ከመፈጸሙ በፊት ከምዕራባውያን አጋሮቻቸው ምንም ዓይነት የቅድመ ማስጠንቀቂያ መረጃ እንዳልደረሳቸው ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni Raashiyaa magaalaa Kiyiv keessatti bu'uuraalee misooma anniisaa irratti xiyyeeffachuun haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwataniiru. Haleellaa kanaan namoonni walakkaa miliyoonaa ol ta'an ibsaa malee hafeera. Preezdaantiin Yuukreen akka ibsanitti, haleellaa kana ilaalchisee hiriyyoonni isaanii gargaarsa odeeffannoo dursaa tokko illee isaaniif hin kennine.

title: Barcola scores hat-trick as Liverpool hit LASK for six
english: Bradley Barcola silenced his critics by scoring his first three goals for Liverpool during a high-scoring 6-3 Champions League victory over LASK. The forward, who recently moved from Paris Saint-Germain, led the team to success alongside other scorers like Ronald Araujo, Jeremie Frimpong, and Lewis Koumas. This win keeps Liverpool undefeated in the tournament and serves as a major confidence boost for manager Andoni Iraola's squad.
amharic: ብራድሊ ባርኮላ ለሊቨርፑል የመጀመሪያዎቹን ሶስት ግቦች በማስቆጠር ተቺዎቹን ዝም አስብሏል። ይህ አጥቂ በቻምፒዮንስ ሊግ ከላስክ ጋር በተደረገው እና 6 ለ 3 በተጠናቀቀው ጨዋታ ላይ ባሳየው አስደናቂ ብቃት ለቡድኑ ድል ወሳኝ ሚና ተጫውቷል። ሊቨርፑል በዚህ ድል በውድድሩ የያዘውን የመቶ በመቶ የማሸነፍ ጉዞ የቀጠለ ሲሆን ለአሰልጣኝ አንዶኒ ኢራኦላም ትልቅ እፎይታን ሰጥቷል።
oromo: Biraadlii Baarkoolaa goolii sadii galchuun golaalee isaa kan duraa Liverpoolf galcheera. Tapha Chaampiyoons Liigii Laask irratti 6-3n Liverpool mo’ate keessatti, baarkoolaan qeeqtoota isaa calliisiiseera. Injifannoon kun Liverpool dorgommii kana irratti injifannoo guutuu akka qabaatu kan taasise yoo ta’u, leenjisaa Andonii Iraolaafis abdii guddaa kenneera.

title: Spanish NGO halts Mediterranean rescue operations, citing fuel prices
english: A Spanish humanitarian organization has suspended its migrant rescue missions in the Mediterranean Sea until next year because of the significant increase in fuel prices. The group has shifted its focus to Spanish coastal waters and is seeking public donations to manage these higher operational costs. This development highlights the ongoing challenges for rescue groups operating along one of the world's most perilous migration routes.
amharic: አንድ የስፔን የበጎ አድራጎት ድርጅት በሜዲትራኒያን ባህር ላይ ሲያደርግ የነበረውን የስደተኞች የማዳን ስራ በነዳጅ ዋጋ መናር ምክንያት እስከሚቀጥለው ዓመት ድረስ አቋርጧል። ድርጅቱ የስራ እንቅስቃሴውን ወደ ስፔን የባህር ዳርቻዎች በመቀየር ተጨማሪ ወጪዎችን ለመሸፈን የህዝብ ድጋፍ እየጠየቀ ይገኛል። ይህ ውሳኔ በዓለም ላይ ካሉ በጣም አስቸጋሪ የስደተኞች ጉዞ መስመሮች አንዱ በሆነው የሜዲትራኒያን ባህር አካባቢ የሚንቀሳቀሱ የበጎ አድራጎት ድርጅቶች እያጋጠሟቸው ያሉትን ተግዳሮቶች የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Dhaabbanni gargaarsa namoomaa kan Ispeen tokko gatiin boba'aa dabaluu isaatiin walqabatee, hojii godaantota galaana Meditiraaniyaan irraa baraaruu hanga waggaa dhufuutti dhaabeera. Dhaabbatichi hojii isaa gara qarqara galaana Ispeenitti kan jijjiirrate yoo ta'u, baasii olka'aa kana dandamachuuf deeggarsa ummataa gaafachaa jira. title: How will a new alliance affect the conflict in eastern DRC?
english: Former Democratic Republic of the Congo President Joseph Kabila has formed a new political and military coalition with M23 rebel forces in the eastern part of the country. title: Starlink restrictions affecting Ukraine's front line operations, Kyiv says
english: Ukrainian officials report that SpaceX has imposed speed restrictions on Starlink terminals, which are hindering military operations such as drone navigation and air defense. These limits, which throttle service for units moving over 160 km/h, were implemented without prior notice to the Ukrainian forces. This development coincides with intense Russian missile strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure that have left hundreds of thousands of people without power.

Daangaan kun meeshaalee waraanaa sa'aatii tokkotti kiilomeetira 160 ol socho'an irratti kan xiyyeeffate yoo ta'u, ajajoonni Yukreen osoo hin beeksisin kan hojiirra ooledha. title: Turkish police raid opposition TV station, halting live broadcasts
english: Turkish authorities recently raided the Istanbul offices of Halk TV, a prominent news channel known for its opposition stance, leading to the suspension of its live broadcasts. The operation involved the detention of several individuals linked to the station's owner, who faces accusations of financial misconduct such as bribery and money laundering. Critics and opposition leaders have condemned the move as a politically motivated attack on press freedom and an attempt to silence government dissent.

oromo: Poolisiin Turkii waajjira televijiinii Halk TV kan mormitoota deeggaru jedhamee beekamu erga weerareen booda, tamsaasa qophiiwwan isaanii addaan kuteera. Qorattoonni yakka faayinaansii abbaa qabeenyaa televijiinii kanaa irratti himannaa malaammaltummaa fi qarshii seeraan alaa dhiquu irratti hundaa'uun namoota tokko tokko to'annoo jala oolchaniiru. Gareen mormitootaa fi dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa tarkaanfiin kun bilisummaa miidiyaa irratti miidhaa qaqqabsiisuu fi mormitoota callisiisuuf mootummaan kan fudhatame akka ta'e ibsaniiru.

title: Saudi-led coalition intercepts Houthi missile launched towards Riyadh
english: The Saudi-led coalition successfully intercepted a ballistic missile fired by Houthi rebels toward Riyadh, following a series of escalating attacks on Saudi territory. These strikes have hit major infrastructure, including Aramco facilities and airports, resulting in significant casualties and property damage. This surge in violence has effectively ended the long-standing ceasefire, leading to renewed military counteroffensives by Saudi-backed forces in Yemen.

title: Iran steps up Hormuz surveillance: Attacks soar, oil flows crash again
english: Iran has intensified its military surveillance and increased attacks on vessels within the Strait of Hormuz. This strategic move aims to challenge the US naval blockade and pressure Washington to lift sanctions on its oil exports. Consequently, these heightened tensions have caused a significant decline in global oil shipments through this critical waterway.

title: Trump plans for ‘massive’ resource exploration in Greenland
english: Donald Trump has announced intentions to begin large-scale extraction of oil, gas, and minerals in Greenland. This initiative follows a recent deal between the United States, Denmark, and Greenland that strengthened the American military's footprint in the Arctic region. The plan signals a significant push to increase resource development in the territory.

title: Settlers set fire to mosque in West Bank as Israeli forces raid villages
english: Israeli settlers recently set fire to a mosque and damaged property in the village of Mikhmas while spray-painting racist slogans. Simultaneously, settlers attacked a young boy in Beita as Israeli military forces conducted multiple raids and arrests throughout the West Bank. These incidents are part of a rising trend of violence and intimidation against Palestinians, particularly targeting farmers during the current olive harvest season.

title: Israeli plan to reopen settler ‘Route 463’ threatens to isolate Ramallah
english: The Israeli military plans to reopen Route 463 for settler traffic, a move that would disconnect several Palestinian villages and neighborhoods in the West Bank. This 10-kilometer road would physically fragment the Ramallah and el-Bireh governorate, forcing tens of thousands of local residents onto severely congested alternative routes. Palestinian officials and organizations argue that this project is part of a broader strategy to disrupt Palestinian land continuity and support illegal settlement expansion.

title: Sudan cannot afford to dismiss a chance for dialogue
english: Sudan is currently facing a devastating, multi-year conflict that cannot be resolved through military action alone. A new initiative led by Sudanese public figures aims to create a path for national dialogue, though it faces criticism from various groups who fear it may favor existing military leadership. While these concerns about neutrality are valid, it is vital to keep this diplomatic channel open rather than rejecting it, as the country desperately needs a political solution to end the suffering.

title: From Cairo to Tokyo: Can you guess these twin cities?
english: The London borough of Hackney is currently considering ending its long-standing sister-city partnership with Haifa, Israel, due to human rights concerns regarding the conflict in Gaza. City twinning, which originated after World War II to foster international peace and cultural exchange, is increasingly being used as a tool for local governments to make symbolic political statements. Hackney council officials are reviewing public feedback before making a final decision on whether to officially dissolve this decades-old relationship.

oromo: Bulchiinsi magaalaa Landan kan ta'e Hackney, waraana Gaazaatti gaggeeffamaa jiruun walqabatee magaalaa Israa'el Haifa waliin walitti dhufeenya isaan qaban xumuruuf mari'achaa jira. Walitti dhufeenyi magaaloolee gartuuwwan lamaa, waraana addunyaa lammaffaa booda nagaa fi waljijjiirraa aadaa cimsuuf kan eegalame yoo ta'u, amma garuu mootummoonni naannoo ejjennoo siyaasaa ibsachuuf itti fayyadamaa jiru. title: Man City deserve to keep trophies despite charges, says PSG’s Luis Enrique
english: Paris Saint-Germain manager Luis Enrique has expressed his support for Manchester City, stating that the club deserves to keep their trophies despite facing serious charges for financial rule violations. While acknowledging that authorities must handle the legal process, Enrique praised the team's on-field performance and hopes they avoid severe sanctions like being stripped of their titles. Manchester City, who deny any wrongdoing, currently face potential penalties including point deductions or relegation as they prepare to host PSG in the Champions League.

oromo: Leenjisaan Paaris Saint-Geermaan Luwiis Enriikee, kilabni Maanchistar Siitii seera maallaqaa cabseera jedhamee himatamee kan jiru ta’us, waancaa inni kanaan dura injifate akka hin dhabne dubbataniiru. title: Ukrainian drones strike more than 100km into Russian territory
english: Ukrainian drones successfully launched an attack deep inside Russian territory, reaching the Saratov region over 100 kilometers from the border. Local authorities confirmed that the strikes resulted in the death of one person and caused significant property damage to residential homes. This incident marks a notable expansion of the reach of Ukrainian aerial operations.
amharic: የዩክሬን ሰው አልባ አውሮፕላኖች (ድሮኖች) ከድንበር በዘለለ ከ100 ኪሎ ሜትር በላይ ርቀት ላይ በሚገኘው የሩሲያ ሳራቶቭ ክልል ላይ ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። የክልሉ አስተዳደር ጥቃቱ የአንድ ሰው ሕይወት ማለፉን እና በበርካታ መኖሪያ ቤቶች ላይ ጉዳት መድረሱን አስታውቋል። ይህ ድርጊት የዩክሬን የአየር ጥቃት የመድረሻ አቅም በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ መጨመሩን ያሳያል።
oromo: Xiyyaawwan eenyu-iyyuu hin fe'in (dronii) kan Yukreen, daangaa irraa gara keessa biyya Raashiyaatti kiilomeetira 100 ol fagaatee naannoo Saaraatoovitti miidhaa geessisaniiru. Gochi kun humnoonni Yukreen meeshaalee waraana isaanii gadi fageenyaan gara biyya Raashiyaatti gadi dhiisuu akka danda'an kan agarsiisuudha.

title: China and North Korea to open New Yalu River Bridge, state media reports
english: China and North Korea are set to officially open the New Yalu River Bridge this Thursday, ending a long delay that started when North Korea left its section unfinished due to international sanctions. While the bridge was intended to increase trade, its opening follows a period of strained relations and shifting diplomatic priorities for Pyongyang. Experts suggest this move reflects the evolving geopolitical dynamics between North Korea, China, and Russia.

title: Germany puts Ukrainian on trial accused of blowing up Nord Stream pipelines
english: A Ukrainian man named Serhii K has gone on trial in Germany, facing charges for his alleged role in the 2022 explosions that destroyed the Nord Stream gas pipelines. Prosecutors believe he worked with a team of divers to sabotage the infrastructure, which they say was intended to disrupt Russian war funding. The suspect denies these claims, and the case remains a complex and politically sensitive issue for Germany as it balances its support for Ukraine with its legal obligations.
amharic: ሰርሂይ ኬ የተባለ የዩክሬን ዜጋ በጀርመን የ2022 የኖርድ ስትሪም የጋዝ ቧንቧ መስመሮችን በማፈንዳት ወንጀል ክስ ቀርቦበት ችሎት መጀመሩ ተገልጿል። አቃቤ ህጎች ተጠርጣሪው ሌሎች ወታደራዊ ሰዎችን በማስተባበር የሩሲያን የጦርነት በጀት ለማሳጣት ሆን ብሎ ጥቃት ፈፅሟል የሚል እምነት አላቸው። ተጠርጣሪው ክሱን በይፋ የካደ ሲሆን፣ ጉዳዩ በጀርመን እና በዩክሬን ግንኙነት ላይ ከፍተኛ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ እና ህጋዊ ውስብስብነት ፈጥሯል።

Shakkamichi yakka kana gadi jedhee kan haale yoo ta'u, dhimmi kun hariiroo Jarmanii fi Yukreen gidduu jiru irratti rakkoo siyaasaa fi seeraa guddaa uumeera.

title: US fines Bank of America $1.2bn for money laundering, sanctions violations
english: The U.S. Treasury has penalized Bank of America over $1.2 billion for failing to follow anti-money laundering and sanctions regulations. The bank was cited for neglecting to report over $5 billion in suspicious transactions and delegating its oversight duties to third parties. Officials emphasized that these record-breaking fines serve as a warning that even major financial institutions must strictly follow national security and legal standards.

title: Namibia battles cattle disease outbreak as EU suspends several meat imports
english: Namibia is facing a serious outbreak of foot-and-mouth disease, leading to strict livestock movement restrictions and the suspension of meat exports to the European Union. This crisis has significantly damaged local markets and small businesses, while causing meat shortages and rising prices for residents. The government is currently working to contain the spread of the virus to protect the country's vital livestock industry and restore economic stability.

oromo: Namibiyaan dhibee afaanifi miilaa jedhamuun rakkattee kan jirtu yoo ta'u, kunis sochiin horii akka daangeffamuufi ergaan foonii gara gamtaa Awurooppaatti godhamu akka dhaabatu taasiseera. Rakkoon kun gabaa naannoofi daldaltoota xixiqqoo irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisee jira; akkasumas fooon akka hir'atuufi gatiin isaas akka dabalu taasiseera. Mootummaan dhibee kana to'achuufi guddina diinagdee biyyattii kan ta'e sektara horii eeguuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jira.

title: Israeli attacks kill one in Gaza, wound journalists in occupied West Bank
english: A recent Israeli airstrike in Gaza City resulted in one fatality and multiple injuries, while a young boy also succumbed to previous wounds. In the occupied West Bank, Israeli military actions led to additional casualties, including a wounded child and journalists affected by tear gas. These incidents highlight the ongoing violence despite the ceasefire anniversary, with reports indicating that Israeli forces have expanded their territorial control across Gaza.
amharic: በጋዛ ከተማ በተፈፀመ የእስራኤል የአየር ድብደባ አንድ ሰው ሲገደል ሌሎች በርካቶች ቆስለዋል፤ ከዚህ ቀደም የቆሰለ አንድ ህጻንም ህይወቱ አልፏል። በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች ህጻናትን ጨምሮ ሌሎች ሰዎችን ለአደጋ የዳረጉ ሲሆን ጋዜጠኞችም በ እንባ ጋዝ ተጎድተዋል። ይህ ሁኔታ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቱ ዓመት ቢሞላውም ግጭቱ አሁንም እንደቀጠለ እና እስራኤል በጋዛ ያላትን ወታደራዊ ቁጥጥር እያሰፋች መሆኑን ያሳያል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el magaalaa Gaazaatti haleellaa qilleensaatiin nam tokko yoo ajjeesu, namoonni biroo immoo madaa'aniiru; daa'imni tokkos madaa darbe kanaan lubbuun isaa darbeera. Gammoojjii Weest Baank keessattis haleellaa Israa'el kanaan daa'imni tokko madaa'ee jiraattoonni fi gaazexeessitoonni gaazii imimmaansuu baasuun miidhamaniiru. Gochootni kun dhaabbii waraanaa sana boodallee waraanni itti fufee akka jiruufi Israa'el harka caalu lafa Gaazaa to'annoo ishee jala galchuu ishee agarsiisa.

title: How podcasts became political powerhouses
english: The 2024 US election highlighted the rising influence of podcasts in shaping political discourse and reaching voters. While these platforms allow candidates to connect with audiences more directly, critics question if they encourage meaningful debate or simply help politicians avoid tough journalistic questioning. Experts are now examining whether this shift enhances democracy or merely creates echo chambers for partisan messaging.
amharic: የ2024 የአሜሪካ ምርጫ ፖድካስቶች በፖለቲካዊ ውይይቶች እና መራጮችን በማሳመን ረገድ ያላቸውን ከፍተኛ ሚና አሳይቷል። እነዚህ መድረኮች እጩዎች በቀጥታ ለህዝብ እንዲናገሩ እድል ቢሰጡም፣ ተቺዎች ግን ጥያቄዎች ያሏቸው የጋዜጠኝነት ስራዎችን ለማምለጥ እንደ መሸሸጊያ ሊያገለግሉ እንደሚችሉ ስጋታቸውን ይገልጻሉ። ይህ ለውጥ ዲሞክራሲን የሚያጠናክር ወይስ ለፖለቲካዊ ወገንተኝነት ማራመጃነት ብቻ የሚውል ነው የሚለው ጉዳይ በአሁኑ ወቅት በባለሙያዎች እየተመረመረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Filannoon US bara 2024 raadiyoonni ykn 'podcast' jedhaman yaada siyaasaa fi yaada ummataa irratti dhiibbaa guddaa akka qaban agarsiiseera. Maree kunneen dorgomtoonni hawaasa waliin kallattiin akka wal-qunnaman gargaaranis, qaamoleen tokko tokko garuu karaa kanaan siyaas-noleen gaaffii gaazexeessitoota cimoo ta'an irraa bilisa akka bahan yaadda'u. Jijjiirramni kun dimokiraasii kan fooyyessu moo faayidaa garee tokkoo qofaaf kan oolu dha kan jedhu irratti hayyoonni ammayyuu mari'achaa jiru.

title: Iran war live: Saudi coalition hits Houthi sites; Aramco office hit in east
english: Tensions escalated as Houthi rebels attacked a Saudi Aramco facility in Dhahran, prompting a retaliatory military response from the Saudi-led coalition against Houthi fuel targets in Yemen. President Trump claimed the rebels are intentionally disrupting energy infrastructure to manipulate oil prices ahead of U.S. elections. Both sides maintain that they are taking measures to minimize civilian harm despite the ongoing regional conflict.
amharic: የሁቲ አማጽያን በሳውዲ አረቢያ የሚገኘውን የአራምኮ ተቋም ማጥቃታቸውን ተከትሎ፣ የሳውዲ ጥምረት በየመን በሚገኙ የሁቲ የነዳጅ ማከማቻዎች ላይ የአጸፋ እርምጃ ወስዷል። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የሁቲ አማጽያን የአሜሪካን ምርጫ በመጠቀም የነዳጅ ዋጋን ለመጨመር ጥቃት እየሰነዘሩ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። በሁለቱም በኩል ያለው ግጭት ቢኖርም፣ ተዋጊዎቹ በሲቪሎች ላይ ጉዳት እንዳይደርስ ጥንቃቄ እያደረጉ መሆናቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Houthonni bu'uuraalee misoomaa Sa'udii Aramco irratti haleellaa raawwachuu isaanii hordofee, gamtaan Sa'udiin durfamu Yemen keessatti iddoo boba'aa Houthoota irratti tarkaanfii deebii fudhateera. Preezidaant Traamp akka jedhanitti, Houthonni filannoo Ameerikaa dura gatii boba'aa dabaluuf jecha bu'uuraalee misoomaa kana kaayyoo godhataniiru. Gidduu kana walitti bu'iinsa jiru keessatti, gareewwan lamaanuu miidhaa siviloota irra gahu hir'isuuf of eeggannoo gochaa akka jiran ibsaniiru.

title: Pope diagnosed with lung cancer but had successful surgery, Vatican says
english: Pope Leo XIV underwent a successful surgical procedure at a Rome hospital to remove a portion of his right lung after being diagnosed with early-stage adenocarcinoma. The growth was discovered during routine medical examinations, and the surgery was performed to ensure the cancer was fully removed. The 71-year-old leader is now recovering in his hospital room, and his public schedule has been paused until October 20th to allow for his recuperation.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ አሥራ አራተኛ በሳንባ ካንሰር እንደተያዙ ከተረጋገጠ በኋላ በሮም በሚገኝ ሆስፒታል የተሳካ የቀዶ ሕክምና ተደረገላቸው። እጢው የተገኘው በመደበኛ የጤና ምርመራ ወቅት ሲሆን፣ ካንሰሩን ሙሉ በሙሉ ለማስወገድ የቀኝ ሳንባ የተወሰነ ክፍል ተቆርጦ ወጥቷል። የ71 ዓመቱ ጳጳስ በአሁኑ ወቅት በሆስፒታል ውስጥ እያገገሙ ሲሆን፣ የጤንነት ሁኔታቸውን ለማሻሻል እስከ ጥቅምት 20 ድረስ ቀጠሮዎቻቸው ተሰርዘዋል።
oromo: Paaphaasii Li'o kudha afuriin (Pope Leo XIV) dhukkuba kaansarii sombaa akka qaban erga mirkanaa'ee booda, magaalaa Roomaa keessatti hodhiinsi isaanii milkaa'inaan raawwatameera. Dhibee sombaa isaanii keessatti argame kana guutummaatti dhaabuuf, kutaan tokko somba isaanii mirgaa hodhiidhaan baafameera. Paaphaasiin umrii waggaa 71 kun yeroo ammaa hospitaala keessatti fayyaa isaanii hordofaa jiru; akkasumas, akka gaariitti boqotanii fayyaniif hanga ji'a Onkololeessa 20tti hojiilee isaanii hunda dhaabanii jiru.

title: Saudi man charged with planting 'sophisticated' recording device in OpenAI office
english: A Saudi engineer employed at OpenAI has been federally charged for allegedly hiding an advanced recording device inside a company conference room in San Francisco. The employee reportedly used AI tools to research how to build and conceal the hardware to eavesdrop on sensitive discussions about the firm's technology. OpenAI discovered the device shortly after it was placed and confirmed that no proprietary code or customer information was compromised during the incident.
amharic: በሳን ፍራንሲስኮ የOpenAI ጽህፈት ቤት ውስጥ የተራቀቀ የመቅረጫ መሳሪያ በመትከል የተጠረጠረ አንድ የሳዑዲ አረቢያ ዜጋ በፌዴራል ክስ ተመሰረተበት። ተጠርጣሪው በኩባንያው ውስጥ በኢንጂነርነት ይሰራ የነበረ ሲሆን፣ ሚስጥራዊ የሆኑ የቴክኖሎጂ ውይይቶችን ለመቅረጽ አርቴፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ መሳሪያዎችን ተጠቅሞ መረጃ እንደፈለገ ተገልጿል። OpenAI መሳሪያውን በፍጥነት በማግኘቱ ምንም አይነት የኩባንያው ምስጢራዊ ኮድ ወይም የደንበኛ መረጃ እንዳልተሰረቀ አረጋግጧል።
oromo: Injinarri lammii Sa’udii kan OpenAI keessa hojjetu tokko, waajjira dhaabbatichaa keessatti meeshaa sagalee waraabu kan seeraan ala hidhe jechuun himatameera. Himatamichi teeknoolojii AI fayyadamuun meeshicha akkamitti akka tolchuufi akka dhoksu qorachuun, mariiwwan xiyyeeffannaa barbaadan hordofuuf yaalii gochuun isaa ibsameera. OpenAI meeshicha yeroodhuma kan argate yoo ta’u, ragaaleenafi koodiin dhaabbatichaa kan hin tuqamneefi hatamne ta’uu mirkaneesseera.

title: MI5 chief warns of threats to UK from Russia, Iran and AI
english: The head of MI5, Sir Ken McCallum, recently warned that threats to the UK from foreign states like Russia and Iran have quadrupled over the last decade. He highlighted that these adversaries are increasingly using hybrid warfare and paying criminal proxies to carry out sabotage. Furthermore, he raised concerns that extremist groups are exploiting artificial intelligence to advance cyber-attacks, drone operations, and potentially dangerous bioweapons.
amharic: የኤምአይ5 (MI5) ዋና ዳይሬክተር ሰር ኬን ማክካለም በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም ላይ ከሩሲያ እና ኢራን የሚመጡ የውጭ ስጋቶች ባለፉት አስር ዓመታት በአራት እጥፍ መጨመራቸውን አስታውቀዋል። እነዚህ አገራት የሳይበር ጥቃቶችን እና የተለያዩ የጥፋት ድርጊቶችን ለመፈጸም ወንጀለኞችን እየቀጠሩ እንደሚጠቀሙም ገልጸዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ አክራሪ ቡድኖች ሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎትን (AI) ተጠቅመው ድሮኖችን እና ባዮሎጂካል መሳሪያዎችን ለማበልጸግ እየሞከሩ መሆኑን አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan dhaabbata basaastotaa UK (MI5) Sir Ken McCallum, biyyoonni alaa akka Raashiyaa fi Iraan UK irratti dhiibbaa geessisan waggaa kudhan darban keessa dachaa afuriin dabaluu isaanii dubbataniiru. Diinonni kun waraana ammayyaafi malaan hojjetamu fayyadamuudhaan, gocha yakkaa raawwachuuf namoota kireeffachaa akka jiran ibsaniiru. Kana malees, gareewwan shororkeessitootaa teknooloojii 'AI' fayyadamuun miidhaa hamaa geessisuuf, keessattuu meeshaalee waraanaafi qoricha du'aa kan biyyooloojii qopheessuuf yaalaa akka jiran akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Missiles intercepted near Riyadh after Saudi coalition hits Yemen fuel depot
english: The Saudi-led coalition conducted airstrikes on a Houthi-controlled fuel facility near Sanaa, Yemen, following a period of heightened conflict. In retaliation, Houthi forces launched missiles and drones toward Riyadh and other Saudi cities, including an Aramco site in Dhahran. While some projectiles caused minor fires, authorities confirmed that there were no casualties resulting from these intercepted attacks.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ የምትመራው ጥምረት በየመን ሰንዓ አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ የሁቲዎች የነዳጅ ማከማቻ ላይ የአየር ድብደባ ፈጽማለች። ለዚህም ምላሽ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሪያድ እና በሌሎች የሳውዲ ከተሞች ላይ ሚሳይሎችን እና ድሮኖችን ተጠቅመው ጥቃት ሰንዝረዋል። ምንም እንኳን ጥቃቶቹ አንዳንድ ቦታዎች ላይ መጠነኛ የእሳት አደጋ ቢያስከትሉም፣ በሰው ላይ የደረሰ ጉዳት አለመኖሩን ባለሥልጣናቱ አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Mootummoonni gamtaa Saudii durfamu, buufata boba'aa kan Houthis to'atamu kan Sana'a bira jiru irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwataniiru. Kanaaf deebii kennuuf, gareen Houthis magaalaa Riyaad fi magaalota Saudi kan biroo irratti mishaayilii fi xiyyaarota nama malee balali'an fayyadamuun haleellaa geggeessaniiru. Haleellaan kunneen iddoowwan tokko tokkotti ibidda xiqqoo kaasuun isaanii fi namni miidhame akka hin jirre hoggantoonni ibsaniiru.

title: Ex-gang boss sentenced to 40 years for orchestrating Tupac Shakur's murder
english: Duane 'Keffe D' Davis has been sentenced to 40 years in prison for his role in the 1996 murder of legendary rapper Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas. Although he was not the shooter, prosecutors proved he was the mastermind who organized the attack and provided the weapon. After nearly three decades of uncertainty, this conviction brings a legal conclusion to the cold case, though Davis intends to appeal the decision.
amharic: ቀድሞ የጋንግ መሪ የነበረው ዱዌን 'ኬፌ ዲ' ዴቪስ እ.ኤ.አ በ1996 በላስ ቬጋስ የታዋቂው ራፐር ቱፓክ ሻኩር ግድያ ላይ እጅ በመኖሩ የ40 ዓመት እስራት ተፈርዶበታል። ምንም እንኳን ጥይቱን ያላረፈው ራሱ ቢሆንም፣ አቃቤ ህግ ግድያውን ያደራጀው እና መሳሪያውን ያቀረበው እርሱ እንደሆነ አስረድተዋል። ለረጅም ዓመታት ሲያወዛግብ የነበረው ይህ የክስ ሂደት ፍርድ ያገኘ ቢሆንም፣ ዴቪስ ብይንን እንደሚቃወም አስታውቋል።
oromo: Duane 'Keffe D' Davis inni duraan hogganaa garee badii ture, ajjeechaa raapparaa beekamaa Tupac Shakur kan bara 1996 magaalaa Las Vegasitti raawwatame keessatti hirmaachuu isaatiin hidhaa waggaa 40 itti murameera. Inni ofii isaa dhukaasa sana kan hin banne ta'us, abbaan alangaa akkaataa ajjeechaa sana itti qindeesseefi meeshaa waraanaa akka dhiyeesse ragaa dhiyeessaniiru. Waggoota soddoma walakkaa booda dhimmichi murtee argatus, Davis murtee kana ol-iyyannoodhaan akka gaafatu ibseera.

title: Albanian police fire tear gas at protesters as Education Ministry attacked
english: Hundreds of students protested in Tirana, Albania, to demand the resignation of Prime Minister Edi Rama and improvements to the national education system. The demonstration escalated into violence as protesters threw bricks and firebombs at the Education Ministry, leading police to respond with tear gas and water cannons. At least 23 people were arrested, and several officers and a journalist were injured during the clash.
amharic: በአልባኒያ ዋና ከተማ ቲራና መቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተማሪዎች የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኤዲ ራማን ስልጣን መልቀቅ እና የትምህርት ሥርዓቱን እንዲሻሻል በመጠየቅ የተቃውሞ ሰልፍ አድርገዋል። ሰልፉ ወደ ሁከት ያመራ ሲሆን ተቃዋሚዎች በትምህርት ሚኒስቴር ላይ ድንጋዮችን እና የቃጠሎ መሳሪያዎችን በመወርወራቸው ፖሊስ አስለቃሽ ጭስ እና የውሃ መድፍ ተጠቅሟል። በግጭቱ ወቅት ቢያንስ 23 ሰዎች በቁጥጥር ስር የዋሉ ሲሆን የፖሊስ አባላት እና አንድ ጋዜጠኛም ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል።
oromo: Magaalaa guddoo Albaniyaa Tiraanaa keessatti barattoonni dhibbaan lakkaa'aman, muummichi ministeeraa Edi Raamaa aangoo gadhiisuu fi sirni barnootaa akka fooyya'u gaafachuun hiriira mormii ba'anii turan. Hiriirichi gara jeequmsaatti kan ce'e yoo ta'u, mormitoonni Ministeera Barnootaatti dhagaa fi meeshaalee ibiddaa waan darbataniif, poolisiin gaazii imimmaaniitiin fi bishaan dhiibbaa qabuun deebii kenneera. Hiriira kanaan namoonni 23 ol to'annoo jala oolanii, poolisootni fi gaazexeessituun tokko miidhamaniiru.

title: Man City vs PSG: Champions League – teams, predictions, line ups
english: Manchester City will host Paris Saint-Germain on Wednesday for their Champions League group stage match at the Etihad Stadium. This game takes place amid significant controversy, as Manchester City faces severe potential penalties following a guilty verdict regarding historical financial rule breaches in the Premier League. Despite the off-field pressure, both teams are in strong form, with fans looking forward to a high-profile showdown between star strikers Erling Haaland and Ferran Torres.
amharic: ማንቸስተር ሲቲ በሻምፒዮንስ ሊግ የሁለተኛው የምድብ ጨዋታ ረቡዕ እለት ፓሪሰን ዠርሜንን (PSG) በሜዳው ያስተናግዳል። ይህ ጨዋታ የሚካሄደው ማንቸስተር ሲቲ በፕሪሚየር ሊግ የፋይናንስ ህጎችን በመተላለፉ ጥፋተኛ ሆኖ ከተገኘ በኋላ ከፍተኛ ውዝግብ ውስጥ ባለበት ወቅት ነው። ከሜዳ ውጪ ያለው የህግ ጫና ቢኖርም ሁለቱም ቡድኖች ጥሩ አቋም ላይ የሚገኙ ሲሆን፣ አድናቂዎችም በኮከብ አጥቂዎቹ በኤርሊንግ ሃላንድ እና በፌራን ቶሬስ መካከል የሚደረገውን የጎል ሽሚያ በጉጉት እየጠበቁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Manchester City Wiixata kana geggeessamuun tapha Champions League garee isaanii irratti Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) mooraa isaaniitti simatu. Taphi kun kan geggeeffamu yeroo Manchester City seera faayinaansii Premier League darbuu isaatiin badii irratti murtaa'ee rakkoo seeraa keessa jiruudha. Dhiibbaa seeraa kana keessa iyyuu, gareen lamaanuu amala gaarii irratti kan argaman yoo ta'u, taphattoonni akka Erling Haaland fi Ferran Torres gidduutti goolii galchuuf qabsoon taasifamu daawwattootaaf hawwataa ta'a jedhamee eegama.

title: US trial begins for Rwandan-American accused of role in genocide
english: A federal court in Boston has started the trial of Eric Nshimiye, a Rwandan-American accused of hiding his involvement in the 1994 Rwandan genocide. Prosecutors claim Nshimiye, a Hutu, participated in violence against Tutsis and lied to U.S. authorities about his actions during that time. He is currently facing charges of perjury and obstruction of justice, which could potentially lead to the loss of his American citizenship if he is convicted.
amharic: በቦስተን የሚገኝ የፌደራል ፍርድ ቤት እ.ኤ.አ. በ1994 በሩዋንዳ የተፈጸመውን የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል ተሳትፎውን ደብቋል በተባለ አሜሪካዊ ዜግነት ባለው ኤሪክ ንሺሚዬ ላይ ክርክሩን ጀምሯል። አቃቤ ህጎች ኤሪክ ንሺሚዬ በቱትሲዎች ላይ በተፈጸመው ግድያ መሳተፉን እና በወቅቱ ስላደረገው ድርጊት ለአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ውሸት መናገሩን ይከራከራሉ። ተከሳሹ በሐሰት ምስክርነት እና የፍትህ ሂደትን በማደናቀፍ ክስ የቀረበበት ሲሆን፣ ጥፋተኛ ሆኖ ከተገኘ የአሜሪካ ዜግነቱን ሊያጣ ይችላል።
oromo: Mana murtii federaalaa Bostonitti argamu, lammii Ameerikaa kan ta'e Eric Nshimiye, bara 1994 biyya Ruwaandaatti fixiinsa sanyii gaggeeffame keessatti hirmaachuu isaa dhokseera jedhamee himatamee irratti dhaddachi eegalameera. Himataan akka jedhutti, Nshimiye namoota gosa Tutsi ta'an irratti ajjeechaa fi miidhaa dhaqqabsiisuu keessatti hirmaachuu fi yeroo sanatti waan raawwate ilaalchisee aangotota Ameerikaa sobuu isaa ibseera. Nshimiye yakka ragaa sobaa dhiyeessuu fi hojii seeraa gufachiisuun himatamee kan jiru yoo ta'u, yoo irratti murteeffame lammummaan Ameerikaa isaa irraa mulqamuu danda'a.

title: Arsenal beat Lille 3-0 as perfect Champions League start continues
english: Arsenal maintained their flawless Champions League record by defeating Lille 3-0 at the Emirates Stadium. After a scoreless first half, the Gunners broke the deadlock through Jurrien Timber before Eberechi Eze and Bukayo Saka secured the victory with quick second-half goals. This win places Arsenal at the top of the competition standings alongside Barcelona and Sporting Lisbon.
amharic: አርሰናል በኤምሬትስ ስታዲየም ሊልን 3-0 በማሸነፍ በቻምፒዮንስ ሊግ የነበረውን ፍጹም አቋም አስቀጥሏል። የመጀመሪያው አጋማሽ ያለ ግብ ከተጠናቀቀ በኋላ፣ ጁሪየን ቲምበር መሪነቱን ያስከበረ ግብ ሲያስቆጥር፣ ኢቤሬቺ ኤዜ እና ቡካዮ ሳካ ተጨማሪ ግቦችን በማከል ድሉን አረጋግጠዋል። በዚህ ውጤት አርሰናል ከባርሴሎና እና ስፖርቲንግ ሊዝበን ጋር በመሆን የውድድሩን ሰንጠረዥ በጋራ እየመራ ይገኛል።
oromo: Arsenal garma arsamaa Emirates irratti Lille 3-0 injifachuun rekordii isaa kan Champions League irratti qabu cimsee itti fufeera. Walakkaan taphichaa jalqabaa gooli malee erga xumuramee booda, Jurrien Timber gooli jalqabaa galchuun Arsenal dursiiseera; itti aansuunis Eberechi Eze fi Bukayo Saka goolota dabalataa galchuun injifannoo kana mirkaneessaniiru. Injifannoon kun Arsenal garee Barcelona fi Sporting Lisbon waliin sadarkaa tokkoffaa irratti akka argamu taasiseera.

title: Pope Leo diagnosed with cancer after surgery to remove part of lung
english: Pope Leo XIV underwent a successful surgery at a Rome hospital to remove a portion of his right lung due to a cancer diagnosis. The 71-year-old leader is currently recovering and has cleared his schedule through October 20. While he is slated for a major tour of Latin America in November, it remains uncertain if his recovery will impact those travel plans.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ አሥራ አራተኛ በሳንባ ካንሰር እንደተያዙ ታውቋል፣ ይህም ተከትሎም በሮም በሚገኝ ሆስፒታል የተሳካ የቀዶ ጥገና ተደርጎላቸው የሳንባው ክፍል እንዲወገድ ተደርጓል። የ71 ዓመቱ ጳጳስ በአሁኑ ወቅት የህክምና ክትትል ላይ ሲሆኑ እስከ ጥቅምት 20 ቀን ድረስ የነበራቸው ቀጠሮዎች በሙሉ ተሰርዘዋል። በህዳር ወር ወደ ላቲን አሜሪካ ለማድረግ ያቀዱት ጉዞ በጤንነታቸው ሁኔታ ምክንያት ሊስተጓጎል እንደሚችል እስካሁን ግልጽ አይደለም።
oromo: Pappaan Leo XIV dhukkuba kansaara sombaa qabaachuu isaanii erga mirkanaa’ee booda, magaalaa Roomaa keessatti baqaqsanii hodhuu (surgery) milkaa’ina qabu godhataniiru. Umuriin isaanii waggaa 71 kan ta’e yoo ta’u, amma fayyaatti jiru; hanga mudde 20 tti sagantaaleen isaanii hundinuu dhaabbataniiru. Ji’a Sadaasaa keessa gara biyyoota Laatin Ameerikaatti imaluuf karoora qabanillee, fayyinni isaanii guutummaatti hamma eeggutti imalli sun akka itti fufu ykn akka hafu ammayyuu murtaa’uu baate.

title: Saudi says four imjured by debris from intercepted missiles over Riyadh
english: Four civilians, including a child and two women, sustained injuries in Riyadh after Saudi forces intercepted two missiles launched by Houthi rebels from Yemen. Falling shrapnel from the destroyed projectiles also caused damage to 15 residential properties. Saudi authorities confirmed the incident through their civil defense agency.
amharic: የየመን የሁቲ አማጽያን ወደ ሳዑዲ አረቢያ ዋና ከተማ ሪያድ የላኳቸው ሁለት ሚሳኤሎች በመከላከያ ኃይሉ ተመተው መውደቃቸውን ተከትሎ፣ ፍርስራሻቸው በደረሰው ጉዳት አራት ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። ጉዳት ከደረሰባቸው መካከል አንድ ሕፃንና ሁለት ሴቶች ይገኙበታል። በተጨማሪም የጥቃቱ ፍርስራሽ በ15 መኖሪያ ቤቶች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሷል።
oromo: Houthiiwwan Yemen irraa gara magaalaa Riyaaditti xiyyara gosa misaa'elaa lama erganiif, humnoota ittisa biyyaa Sa'udiitiin erga dhuka'anii booda caccabaan isaanii kuffisameera. Caccabaa kana irraa miidhaan qaamaa namoota afur, kanneen keessaa daa'ima tokko fi dubartoota lama irratti gaheera. Kana malees, caccabaan kun manneen jireenyaa 15 irratti miidhaa geessiseera.

title: Opinion: Austria's anti-terror laws are turning journalism about Palestine into a crime
english: Mustafa Ayyash, a Palestinian journalist and founder of Gaza Now, has been detained in Austria since November 2025 under broad anti-terror laws. Critics argue that these regulations are being used to criminalize journalism and political speech related to the situation in Gaza. Under current Austrian law, authorities can charge individuals for supporting prohibited groups even without direct membership, raising significant concerns about press freedom.
amharic: የጋዛ ናው መስራች የሆኑት ፍልስጤማዊው ጋዜጠኛ ሙስጠፋ አያሽ ከኖቬምበር 2025 ጀምሮ በኦስትሪያ በሽብርተኝነት ክስ ታስረው ይገኛሉ። የኦስትሪያ መንግስት ተግባራዊ እያደረገ ያለው ሰፊ የፀረ-ሽብር ህግ ጋዜጠኝነትን እና ስለ ጋዛ ሁኔታ የሚደረግ የፖለቲካ አስተያየትን ለወንጀል እየዳረገ መሆኑን ተቺዎች ይናገራሉ። የአገሪቱ ህግ ለአንድ ታጣቂ ቡድን ቀጥተኛ አባል ባይሆኑም እንኳን ድጋፍ አድርገዋል ተብለው እንዲከሰሱ ስለሚፈቅድ፣ ይህ አሰራር በፕሬስ ነፃነት ላይ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Gaazexeessaan Falastiinii fi hundeessaan 'Gaza Now' Mustafaa Ayyaash, seerota shororkeessummaa ittisuu Oustiriyaa jala jiran fayyadamuudhaan Hagayya 2025 irraa eegalee hidhamee jira. Muxannoon isaa kun seerota Oustiriyaa keessatti gaazexeessummaa fi ibsa siyaasaa gaaza irratti xiyyeeffatu yakka gochuuf itti fayyadamamaa jiraachuu isaa qeeqonni ibsu. Seerri biyyattii kun namni tokko garee dhowwame tokkoof deeggarsa godhe yoo shakkame, miseensa garee sanaa ta'uu baatus yakka irratti banuun mirga gaazexeessummaa irratti sodaa uumee jira.

title: Israeli forces injure two Palestinians with rubber-coated metal bullets, west of Ramallah
english: Two Palestinians were wounded in the head by rubber-coated metal bullets fired by Israeli forces near the village of Ras Karkar in the West Bank. The incident occurred as the individuals attempted to cross a closed gate that restricts travel between local villages. The victims have since been transported to a hospital in Ramallah to receive medical care.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ ራስ ካርካር መንደር አቅራቢያ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን ላይ የጎማ ጥይቶችን በመተኮስ ጉዳት አድርሰዋል። ጉዳቱ የደረሰው ግለሰቦቹ በአካባቢው መንደሮች መካከል ያለውን የተዘጋ መግቢያ በር ለማለፍ ሲሞክሩ ነው። ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሰዎች ለህክምና ወደ ረማላ ሆስፒታል ተወስደዋል።
oromo: Raammallaa dhihaatti argamtu baadiyyaa Raas Kaarkaartitti, humnoonni Israa'el namoota Palastinii lama irratti rasaasa reebaraa fayyadamuun mataa isaanii miidhan. Namoonni kunneen miidhaan kan irra ga'e, giddugala gandaa fi daandii cufame irra darbuu yaaluu isaaniitiin. Namoonni miidhaan irra ga'e kunis yaalamuu fi yaalamuu danda'uuf gara hospitaala Raammallaatti geessifamaniiru.

title: Trump says he does not believe China and Russia help Iran, contradicting US intelligence
english: Former President Donald Trump has publicly rejected claims that Russia and China are providing support to Iran. His statement contradicts recent findings from American intelligence agencies, which suggest both nations are supplying military components and satellite data to Tehran. Trump argues that these countries would not risk their own interests by assisting Iran in such a way.
amharic: የቀድሞው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ሩሲያ እና ቻይና ኢራንን ይረዳል የሚለውን መረጃ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ይህ አስተያየታቸው ሁለቱ ሀገራት ለኢራን ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ እያደረጉ እንደሆነ ከገለጹ የአሜሪካ የስለላ መረጃዎች ጋር ይጋጫል። ትራምፕ እነዚህ ሀገራት በኢራን ጉዳይ ጣልቃ በመግባት የራሳቸውን ጥቅም አደጋ ላይ አይጥሉም ሲሉ ተከራክረዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantii duraanii Donald Traamp, biyyoonni Raashiyaa fi Chaayinaan Iraan gargaaraa jiru jedhu mormaniiru. Yaadni kun odeeffannoo qorannoo ICC Amerikaa biyyoonni kunneen meeshaalee waraanaa fi odeeffannoo istaatelaayitiin Iraaniif kennu jedhu kan mormuu dha. Traamp akka jedhanitti, biyyoonni kunneen faayidaa mataa isaanii miidhuuf jecha Iraan gargaaruuf carraa hin qaban.

title: Saudi Arabia hit by multiple explosions after strikes on Yemeni oil facility
english: Tensions have escalated significantly as Saudi Arabia launched airstrikes against Houthi-controlled oil facilities in Yemen's capital, Sanaa. In response, Houthi rebels retaliated by launching a series of drone and missile attacks that caused explosions across several Saudi Arabian cities. The Saudi-led coalition had previously advised civilians to evacuate the targeted areas in Yemen before the military operations began.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ በየመን ዋና ከተማ ሰንዓ የሚገኙ የሁቲ አማፂያን የነዳጅ ማቀነባበሪያ ጣቢያዎችን በመምታቷ በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል ያለው ግጭት ተባብሷል። ለዚህም ምላሽ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሳውዲ አረቢያ ዋና ዋና ከተሞች ላይ በድሮን እና በሮኬት ጥቃት አድርሰዋል። ጥቃቱ ከመፈፀሙ በፊት የሳውዲ ጥምር ጦር በየመን የሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች አካባቢውን ለቀው እንዲወጡ አስጠንቅቆ ነበር።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan buufatawwan boba'aa magaalaa Sana'aa keessatti argamanii fi harka warra Huutii jiran erga haleeltee booda, walitti bu'iinsi biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru daran hammaateera. Kana boodas, finxaaleyyin Huutii deebii kennaniin magaalota Saudii Arabiyaa gara garaa irratti haleellaa xiyyaara kashilaa fi rookeetiin raawwataniiru. Gamtaan Saudii durfamu haleellaa kana dura namoota naannoo sana jiran akka gadhiisanii bahaniif akeekkachiisa kennee ture.

title: Cornell bans all fraternity parties over gang sex assault allegations
english: Cornell University has officially banned all parties at fraternity houses for the remainder of the academic year following a lawsuit regarding a serious sexual assault incident from 2024. University President Michael Kotlikoff apologized for the institution's previous failures and announced new partnerships with state police to improve how sexual violence cases are handled. The school also plans to increase resources and support staff for survivors to ensure better safety and reporting processes on campus.
amharic: ኮርኔል ዩኒቨርሲቲ እ.ኤ.አ. በ2024 የተፈጸመውን የጾታዊ ጥቃት ክስ ተከትሎ በቀሪው የትምህርት ዘመን በወንዶች ማህበር (fraternity) ቤቶች ውስጥ ፓርቲዎችን ሙሉ በሙሉ ከልክሏል። የዩኒቨርሲቲው ፕሬዝዳንት ሚካኤል ኮትሊኮፍ ተቋሙ በጉዳዩ ላይ ቀደም ሲል የነበረውን መዘናጋት ይቅርታ በመጠየቅ፣ ለወደፊት የጾታዊ ጥቃት ምርመራዎች ከፖሊስ ጋር በመተባበር የተሻለ እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ አስታውቀዋል። በተጨማሪም ዩኒቨርሲቲው ጥቃት የደረሰባቸው ተማሪዎችን ለመደገፍ እና አቤቱታዎችን በብቃት ለመቀበል የሚያስችል አዲስ ድጋፍ እና ሰራተኞችን እንደሚመድብ ገልጿል።
oromo: Yuunivarsiitiin Koornel himata haleellaa saalaa bara 2024 raawwatame jedhamee dhiyaate hordofee, mana barnootichaatti godamboota keessatti qophii bashannanaa fi birmadummaa guyyoota barnootaa hafan hundaaf dhorkeera. Preezidaantiin yuunivarsiitichaa Maayikil Kootliikof rakkoo duraan mudateef dhiifama gaafachuu fi fuulduratti qorannoo haleellaa saalaa irratti poolisii waliin ta'uun tarkaanfii cimaa akka fudhatan beeksisaniiru. Kana malees, yuunivarsiitichi kanneen miidhaan irra gahe deeggaruu fi komii isaanii karaa sirrii ta'een qabachuu akka danda'an hojjettoota dabalataa qaxaruuf karoora baaseera.

title: Watch: Emergency calls from botched Christa Pike execution released
english: Newly released audio recordings highlight significant delays during the failed execution of death row inmate Christa Pike in Tennessee. First responders were initially confused about whether the call for assistance from the prison was authentic, leading to wasted time. Pike, who was convicted of murder in 1995, survived two lethal injections and was subsequently transported to a hospital in critical condition.
amharic: በቅርቡ ይፋ የተደረጉ የድምጽ ቅጂዎች በቴነሲ ግዛት የሞት ፍርድ ተፈጻሚ ሊደረግባት የነበረችው ክሪስታ ፓይክ ላይ የተደረገው ሙከራ መክሸፉን እና በሂደቱም ከፍተኛ መዘግየቶች እንደነበሩ ያሳያሉ። የድንገተኛ አደጋ ሠራተኞች ከእስር ቤቱ የተደወለላቸው ጥሪ እውነት መሆኑን ለማረጋገጥ በመቸገራቸው ጊዜው እንዲባክን አድርጓል። በ1995 በነፍስ ግድያ ወንጀል የተፈረደባት ፓይክ፣ ሁለት ጊዜ ገዳይ መርዝ ከተሰጠች በኋላ በሕይወት በመትረፏ በአስጊ ሁኔታ ወደ ሆስፒታል ተልካለች።
oromo: Sagaleen suuraa waraabamee gadhiifame, keessatti haala wal-ga'ii hin taaneen yaaliin adabbii du'aa Kristaa Paayik irratti godhame akka fashale ibseera. Hojjettoonni gargaarsa ariifachiisaa, waamichi mana hidhaa irraa dhufe dhugaa ta'uu isaa mirkaneeffachuu irratti wal-dhabuun isaani yeroo dheeraa akka qisaasamu godheera. Paayik, bara 1995 yakka ajjeechaan kan murteeffamte yoo ta'u, qorichi du'aa lamaan isheetti godhame milka'uu dhabee, haala cimaa keessatti gara hospitaalaatti ergamteetti.

title: China sentences three people to death for running Myanmar scam centres
english: A Chinese court has sentenced three leaders of a criminal syndicate to death for running large-scale scam compounds in Myanmar. The gang deceived thousands of people with false job promises and was involved in serious crimes, including human trafficking, murder, and financial fraud totaling over $1.8 billion. In addition to the death sentences, 58 other members were given various prison terms as part of Beijing's aggressive crackdown on illegal operations in Southeast Asia.
amharic: የቻይና ፍርድ ቤት በማያንማር ውስጥ ሕገ-ወጥ የማታለል ድርጊቶችን ሲፈጽሙ የነበሩ የሶስት የወንጀል ቡድን መሪዎችን በሞት ቀጣ። ቡድኑ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን በስራ ዕድል በማታለል በሰው ዝውውር፣ በግድያ እና በ1.8 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሚገመት የገንዘብ ማጭበርበር ወንጀሎች ተሳትፏል። የቻይና መንግስት በደቡብ ምስራቅ እስያ የሚከናወኑ መሰል ወንጀሎችን ለመቆጣጠር በሚያደርገው ዘመቻ፣ ሌሎች 58 የቡድኑ አባላትም በተለያዩ የዕድሜ ልክ እና ሌሎች እስራት ተቀጥተዋል።
oromo: Mana murtii Chaayinaa tokko garee yakka hojjetu kan Maayaanmar keessatti bakka sobaafi gowwoomsuu gaggeessaa ture hogganan sadii irratti adabbii du'aa murteesse. Gareen kun namoota kumaatamaan lakka'aman hojii sobaan gowwoomsuun, nama gurguruu, ajjeechaa fi yakka maallaqa doolaara biiliyoona 1.8 oliin walqabatu raawwachaa ture. Mootummaan Chaayinaa yakka kana dhaabsisuuf tarkaanfii cimaa fudhataa jiruun, miseensonni garee kanaa kanneen biroo 58 ta'an adabbii hidhaa waggaa dheeraa fudhataniiru.

title: Cholera cases surge in Yemen as conflict intensifies, WHO says
english: The World Health Organization reports a sharp rise in cholera cases in Yemen, driven by renewed fighting that has displaced over 200,000 people into unsanitary camps. With over 8,000 suspected cases and 27 deaths recorded this year, health officials warn that the situation is worsening rapidly in the southwest. Urgent international funding and better access to clean water and medical care are needed to prevent a larger health catastrophe.
amharic: የዓለም የጤና ድርጅት በየመን በተቀሰቀሰው አዲስ ግጭት ሳቢያ ከ200 ሺህ በላይ ሰዎች በመፈናቀላቸውና ንጽህና በጎደላቸው መጠለያዎች በመጠለላቸው የኮሌራ በሽታ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እየተስፋፋ መሆኑን አስታውቋል። በዚህ ዓመት ብቻ ከ8 ሺህ በላይ የተጠረጠሩ የኮሌራ ጉዳዮች እና 27 ሞቶች የተመዘገቡ ሲሆን፣ ሁኔታው በደቡብ ምዕራብ የየመን ክፍሎች እያሳሰበ ነው። ወረርሽኙን ለመቆጣጠር አስቸኳይ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ፣ ንጹህ ውሃ እና የህክምና አገልግሎት ማቅረብ እንደሚያስፈልግ ድርጅቱ አሳስቧል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Fayyaa Addunyaa (WHO) waraana Yaman keessatti deebi'ee qabateen namoonni 200,000 ol ta'an buqqa'anii bakkeewwan qulqullina hin qabne keessa jiraachuu isaaniitiin dhibee koleeraan daran babal'achaa jiraachuu beeksise. Bara kana keessa qofa namoonni 8,000 ol shakkii dhibichaan qabamanii fi 27 du'uun isaanii kan ibsame yoo ta'u, rakkoon kun kibba-lixaa biyyattii keessatti hammaachaa jira. Dhibicha to'achuuf gargaarsa ariifachiisaa, bishaan qulqulluu fi tajaajila fayyaa dhiyeessuun barbaachisaa ta'uu dhaabbatichi akeekkachiiseera.

title: New White House press secretary Katie Zacharia holds first briefing
english: Katie Zacharia has officially conducted her inaugural press briefing as the new White House press secretary, succeeding Karoline Leavitt. Formerly a media commentator and adviser for Trump Media, she used the platform to announce the resignation request for Kimberly Guilfoyle, the current US ambassador to Greece. This move marks one of her first major administrative updates in her new leadership role.

title: Iran summons British ambassador over Fairford air base incident, foreign ministry says
english: Iran has officially summoned the British ambassador to protest claims that the country was involved in a suspected plot against the Fairford air base. Prime Minister Andy Burnham previously stated that the attack plan was likely coordinated from within Iran, which the Iranian government strongly denies. Tehran has demanded that Britain provide concrete evidence for these allegations and warned that failure to do so could negatively impact their diplomatic relationship.

title: Yemen's Houthis threaten Saudi Aramco sites after coalition strikes in Sanaa
english: The Houthi rebels in Yemen have issued a warning to civilians and workers to stay away from Saudi Aramco oil facilities, labeling them as potential military targets. This threat followed an order from the Saudi-led coalition for people to vacate a state-run oil site in Sanaa before an anticipated airstrike. The Houthi group stated that any military action against Sanaa would be countered with aggressive attacks on major infrastructure in Riyadh.

english: Ukraine's former commander-in-chief, Oleksandr Syrskyi, stated that the country has successfully halted Russian progress by inflicting significant casualties on their forces. Syrskyi attributed the current battlefield deadlock to this disparity in losses, combined with Ukraine's improved defensive strategies and technological developments.

title: One dead and several hurt after rollercoaster incident at Six Flags
english: A tragic accident occurred at the Six Flags Over Georgia amusement park, resulting in the death of one person and injuries to several others on a rollercoaster. Local police are currently investigating the circumstances, though official details regarding how the incident happened remain limited. Reports from witnesses suggest a rider fell from the attraction, and park officials are cooperating fully with the ongoing investigation.

title: US emergency call records reveal confusion after failed execution of Christa Pike
english: Recently released emergency call records reveal significant confusion among Tennessee prison officials following a failed lethal injection execution of convicted murderer Christa Pike. The internal miscommunication caused delays in medical care after the two doses of drugs administered failed to end her life. Pike is currently back in prison after recovering from the incident, creating an unprecedented legal situation as she is believed to be the only person to survive such an execution attempt.

title: Israel’s military raids NGO offices in Ramallah
english: Israeli military forces conducted raids on several non-governmental organization offices located in Ramallah within the occupied West Bank. These actions have drawn attention to the ongoing tension and the military's reach into civil society institutions in the region.

oromo: Al-Jazeeran gabaasa dhiyeenya kana dhiyeesseen, biyyi Qatar namoota qaama miidhamtoota autismii (autism) qaban gargaaruuf carraaqqii taasisaa jirtu xiyyeeffannoo keessa galcheera. Sagantaan kun, biyyattiin sadarkaa biyyaalessatti, naannootti fi addunyaatti pirojektiiwwan garaagaraa hojiirra oolchaa jirtu qorata. Hojiiwwan kunis, hawaasa autismii qabanuf hubannoo, hirmaannaa fi carraa gargaarsa hawaasummaa guddisuuf kan kaayyeeffatanidha.

title: Trump Protester punched at Trump rally as they’re mocked by the president
english: During a political rally in Youngstown, Ohio, a protester was physically assaulted by supporters of Donald Trump. The individual, who wore a shirt demanding the release of Epstein-related documents, was also ridiculed by the former president as security personnel escorted them from the venue. This incident highlights the volatile atmosphere often present at these public campaign events.

oromo: Youngstown, Ohio keessatti walgahii siyaasaa Donald Trump irratti namni tokko kan mormii qabu deggertoota isaatiin reebameera. Namichi kun kan mormii qabu kun uffata waa'ee galmee Epstein ilaalchisuun dubbatu kan uffate yoo ta'u, yeroo humnoonni nageenyaa isa bakka sanaa baasanis Donald Trump isatti qoosaniiru. Gochi kun walgahiiwwan siyaasaa gurguddoo irratti mudatuu kan danda'u wal-dhabdee fi miira cimaa agarsiisa.

title: Activist Greta Thunberg joins French student protests
english: Climate activist Greta Thunberg has joined French students in Saint-Denis as they protest against poor educational conditions, including staff shortages and overcrowded classrooms. The movement, which involves hundreds of schools nationwide, is calling for greater inclusion in political decision-making and better school infrastructure. Recent demonstrations have faced significant tension, with students reporting concerns over police treatment while teachers and union members show their support through organized marches.
amharic: የአየር ንብረት ተሟጋቿ ግሬታ ተንበርግ በፈረንሳይ በትምህርት ተቋማት ውስጥ ያሉ የከፋ ሁኔታዎችን እና የመምህራን እጥረትን በመቃወም ላይ ካሉ ተማሪዎች ጋር ተቀላቅላለች። በመላ አገሪቱ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ትምህርት ቤቶችን ያሳተፈው ይህ የተማሪዎች እንቅስቃሴ ለትምህርት ቤት መሠረተ ልማት ማሻሻያ እና በፖለቲካ ውሳኔዎች ላይ ተሳትፎ እንዲኖራቸው እየጠየቀ ነው። ሰልፎቹ በፖሊስ የኃይል እርምጃ ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ውጥረት ውስጥ የገቡ ሲሆን፣ መምህራን እና የሠራተኛ ማህበራት ተማሪዎችን በመደገፍ ሰላማዊ ሰልፎችን እያካሄዱ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Duudhaa jijjiirama qilleensaa Gireetaa Tunbeerg barattoota Faransaay mana barumsaa isaanii keessatti haala mijaataa dhabuu fi hanqina barsiisotaa mormaa jiran cinaa dhaabbatteetti. Sochii biyyoolessa kana keessatti manneen barnootaa dhibbootaan lakkaawaman hirmaachaa jiran yoo ta'u, bu'uuraalee barnootaa fooyyessuu fi dhimma isaanii irratti dhaggeeffatamuu gaafachaa jiru. Hiriirri kun humna poolisii irratti kan xiyyeeffate ta'uu isaa fi sodaa dararaa poolisii qaban ilaalchisee barattoonni komachaa jiran; gama biraatiin immoo barsiisonni fi gamtaaleen hojjattootaa hiriira kana deeggaraa jiru.

title: One killed, several injured in Georgia rollercoaster ‘incident’
english: A fatal accident occurred on a rollercoaster at a Six Flags amusement park in Georgia, resulting in one death and multiple injuries. Following the incident, the company temporarily shut down nine similar rides across several locations as a safety precaution. Local authorities are currently investigating the circumstances surrounding the event to determine exactly how the tragedy took place.

oromo: Buufata bashannanaa 'Six Flags' kan naannoo Joorjiyaa keessatti, makiinaa taphaa 'rollercoaster' iratti balaa tasaa mudateen namni tokko lubbuun isaa darbee kanneen biroo irratti miidhaan ga’eera. Kompaaniin kun balaa kana hordofee, of eeggannoo duraa fudhachuuf jechuudha, makiinoota wal-fakkaatan sagal paarkota isaanii gara garaa keessatti yeroof cufaniiru. Abbootiin taayitaa naannichaa haala balaan kun itti mudate irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: Saudi Arabia refuses request from Netanyahu to join fight against Houthis, says report
english: Saudi Arabia has turned down a proposal from Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to collaborate in military actions against Houthi forces in Yemen. Netanyahu had hoped this cooperation would improve diplomatic relations between the two nations through American mediation. However, the Saudi leadership rejected the offer due to concerns about potential public disapproval, and ongoing regional tensions have further stalled progress toward normalizing ties.
amharic: ሳዑዲ አረቢያ በየመን የሚንቀሳቀሱትን የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ለመዋጋት የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ያቀረቡትን ጥያቄ ውድቅ አድርጋለች። ኔታንያሁ በአሜሪካ አማካኝነት ይህንን ጥያቄ ያቀረቡት ከሳዑዲ አረቢያ ጋር ያላቸውን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት ለማጠናከር ነበር። ይሁን እንጂ የሳዑዲ መሪዎች በሀገራቸው ህዝብ ዘንድ ሊፈጠር የሚችለውን ተቃውሞ በመስጋት ጥያቄውን አልተቀበሉትም፣ እንዲሁም በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ያለው ጦርነት የሁለቱን ሀገራት ግንኙነት የመመስረት ተስፋን አዳክሞታል።
oromo: Mootummaan Saudii Arabiyaa, mummichi ministeeraa Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahu humnoota Houtii Yemen keessa jiran irratti waraana gaggeessuuf dhiyeessan fudhachuu dide. Ta'us, hogganoonni Saudii mormii uummataa sodaachuun akkaataa kanaan Israa'el waliin hojjechuu didan; akkasumas waraanni Gaaza keessa jiru hariiroo biyyoota kana lamaanii idileessuuf karoorfamee ture gufachiiseera.

title: Hunger strike in Lebanese prisons ends after settlement over amnesty bill reached
english: Prisoners in Lebanon have ended a 30-day hunger strike following an agreement regarding a long-delayed general amnesty bill. This legislation was initially paused due to legal challenges, but a constitutional ruling has now allowed it to proceed with specific revisions. The law is intended to address severe overcrowding in facilities like Roumieh prison, where thousands of detainees have faced prolonged periods without trials.

oromo: Hidhamtoonni Libanon seera dhiifama waliigalaa yeroo dheeraaf harkifataa ture irratti walii galteen erga irra ga’ee booda, guyyoota 30f adeemsisaa turan sagantaa beelaa dhaabaniiru. Seerri kun mormii seeraa irraa kan ka'e addaan citee ture, haa ta'u malee mana maree seera bu'uuraa biyyattitiin fooyya'iinsi erga irratti godhamee booda hojiirra ooluuf murtaa'eera. title: Egypt links its national security to Gulf security after GCC talks
english: Egyptian Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty recently met with the head of the Gulf Cooperation Council to discuss regional stability. During the talks, he emphasized that Egypt views the safety and security of Gulf nations as inseparable from its own national interests. He further pledged Egypt's continued support and solidarity with Saudi Arabia.

oromo: Ministirri dhimma alaa biyya Gibxii Badr Abdelatty hoggansa waliigaltee gargaarsa biyyoota Gulf waliin mari'ataniiru. Marii isaaniitiin, nageenyi biyyoota Gulf nageenya biyya Gibxii waliin walqabata jedhaniiru. title: Saudi Arabia refuses request from Netanyahu to join fight against Houthis, says report
english: Saudi Arabia has rejected an Israeli proposal to cooperate in military operations against Houthi forces in Yemen. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu sought this partnership to improve diplomatic relations, but Saudi leadership declined due to concerns about potential public disapproval. Meanwhile, Iran has urged Saudi Arabia to seek a peaceful, diplomatic resolution to the ongoing conflict rather than escalating military action.

oromo: Sa’udii Arabiyaan waraana Yemen keessa jiru irratti hirmaachuuf dhiyeessii isaan Israel irraa dhufe diddeetti. Ministirri Muummee Benjamin Netanyahu hariiroo isaanii fooyyeffachuuf gargaarsa gochuuf yaalii godhanis, mootummaan Sa’udii mormii ummataa sodaachuun yaada kana fudhachuu dideera. Gama biraan, biyyi Iraan, Sa’udiin rakkoo kana karaa waraanaatiin osoo hin taane, marii fi karaa nagaan akka furattu gorsa kenniteetti.

title: Trump insists energy ceasefire holds as Ukraine reports new Russian strikes
english: President Donald Trump claims that Russia and Ukraine have agreed to stop attacking each other’s energy infrastructure to help de-escalate the conflict. However, Ukraine reports that Russia has already violated this purported truce by striking multiple energy facilities since the announcement. Trump continues to urge both leaders to end the war, despite skepticism from officials and ongoing military activity on the ground.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ሩሲያ እና ዩክሬን እርስ በርስ የሚፈጽሙትን የኃይል ማመንጫ ተቋማት ጥቃት ለማቆም መስማማታቸውን ተናግረዋል። ሆኖም ዩክሬን ይህ ስምምነት ከተገለጸ በኋላ ሩሲያ በበርካታ የኃይል ማመንጫ ተቋማት ላይ ጥቃት በመሰንዘር ስምምነቱን እንደጣሰች አስታውቃለች። ትራምፕ ሁለቱ ወገኖች ግጭቱን እንዲያቆሙ ቢገፋፉም፣ በየብስ ላይ ያለው የጦርነት እንቅስቃሴ እና ጥርጣሬዎች ግን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp, Raashiyaan fi Yukireeniin buufataalee anniisaa irratti miidhaa geessisuu dhaabuuf waliigaluu isaanii dubbataniiru. Haa ta'u malee, Yukireeniin erga ibsi kun kennamee booda Raashiyaan buufataalee anniisaa hedduu irratti haleellaa raawwachuudhaan waliigaltee kana cabsuu ishee beeksisteetti. Tiraamp gartuuleen lamaanuu waraana kana akka dhaaban dhiibbaa gochaa jiranis, lafa irratti haleellaan fi shakkiin gama lameen irraayyuu itti fufee jira.

title: Russia and Ukraine trade strikes amid doubt over ‘energy ceasefire’
english: Despite claims by Donald Trump regarding an 'energy ceasefire,' Russia and Ukraine are continuing to exchange military strikes. President Zelenskyy confirmed that Russian attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure remain ongoing. Neither government in Moscow or Kyiv has officially verified that a ceasefire agreement actually exists.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ስለ 'የኢነርጂ ተኩስ አቁም' ቢናገሩም፣ በሩሲያ እና በዩክሬን መካከል ያለው ወታደራዊ ግጭት ቀጥሏል። ፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ የሩሲያ ጥቃቶች በዩክሬን የኃይል ማመንጫ ተቋማት ላይ እየተፈጸሙ መሆናቸውን አረጋግጠዋል። የሞስኮ እና የኪየቭ መንግስታት ምንም አይነት የጦርነት ማቆም ስምምነት ላይ አለመደረሱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Donald Trump waa'ee 'hiriira waraanaa humna ibsaa' irratti ibsa kennus, gidduu Russia fi Ukraine waraanni ammallee itti fufee jira. Pirezidaanti Zelenskyy akka ibsanitti, rukutaan Russia kan bu'uuraalee misooma ibsaa Ukraine irratti gaggeeffamu itti fufee jira. Mootummoonni lamaanuu waliigaltee akkasii irra gahuu isaanii hanga ammaatti hin mirkaneessine.

title: Cyberattack on French supermarkets causes fires, millions in losses
english: A major cyberattack targeted refrigeration systems at French supermarkets, causing temperatures to rise drastically to 50 degrees Celsius. This manipulation resulted in store fires and the forced disposal of massive amounts of spoiled food. The incident has caused significant financial losses and led to empty store shelves across the country.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ የሚገኙ የሱፐርማርኬት መደብሮች የቀዘቀዙ ምርቶች ማቆያ ስርዓት ላይ በደረሰ የሳይበር ጥቃት ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሷል። ጠላፊዎች የሙቀት መጠኑን ወደ 50 ዲግሪ ሴልሺየስ ከፍ በማድረጋቸው መደብሮች ውስጥ እሳት እንዲነሳና እጅግ ብዙ የምግብ ክምችቶች እንዲበላሹ አድርጓል። በዚህም የተነሳ መደብሮች ባዶ በመሆናቸው ሀገሪቱ ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ኪሳራ ገጥሟታል።
oromo: Hojiin garee suuqiiwwan gurguddoo Faransaay keessa jiran irratti qiyyaafate, sirna qabbaneessuu meeshaalee nyaataa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessiseera. Hakaroonni ho'a qabbaneessitootaa gara digrii 50 seelsiyesitti ol guddisuun, suuqiiwwan keessatti ibidda kaasuufi nyaanni hedduun akka manca'u taasisaniiru. Kanaanis miidhaan maallaqaa guddaan mudachuun, suuqiiwwan biyyattii hedduu keessatti meeshaaleen akka dhabaman ta'eera.

title: ‘Unprecedented’ cyberattack hits French supermarkets, causing food losses
english: A massive cyberattack recently targeted the refrigeration systems of hundreds of French supermarkets, causing temperatures to rise and destroying large quantities of food. The hack, which forced remote defrosting, also triggered fires in several retail locations across the country. French authorities have launched an investigation into the incident, which retailers estimate could result in tens of millions of euros in damages.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ የሚገኙ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሱፐርማርኬቶች ላይ የደረሰ መጠነ ሰፊ የሳይበር ጥቃት፣ የቀዝቃዛ ማቀዝቀዣዎችን የሙቀት መጠን በመጨመሩ ከፍተኛ መጠን ያለው የምግብ ክምችት እንዲበላሽ አድርጓል። ጠላፊዎቹ የማቀዝቀዣ ሥርዓቶችን በርቀት በመቆጣጠር ባደረሱት በዚህ ጥቃት፣ በበርካታ መደብሮች ውስጥ የእሳት ቃጠሎም ተከስቷል። የፈረንሳይ መንግሥት ጉዳዩን በቁም ነገር በመመልከት ምርመራ የጀመረ ሲሆን፣ የደረሰው ጉዳት በአስር ሚሊዮን የሚቆጠር ዩሮ ሊደርስ እንደሚችል ተገምቷል።
oromo: Hojiin garee gaggabaataa kompitaraa (cyberattack) gurguddaa biyya Faransaay keessatti argaman irratti raawwatameen, sirni qabbaneessaa (refrigeration) isaan miidhamuun nyaanni baay'een akka badu ta'eera. Hattuun teeknooloojii kun sirna qabbaneessaa maashinoota kanaa jijjiiruun, iddoowwan tokko tokkotti ibidda kaasuun isaa gabaafameera. Mootummaan Faransaay qorannoo eegale yoo ta'u, miidhaan ga'e tilmaamaan hanga miiliyoona dhibbaatti kan lakkawamuufi qarshii baay'ee akka balleesse ibsameera.

title: Ethiopia’s Tigray war: Where do the UAE and Saudi Arabia stand?
english: The renewed conflict in Ethiopia's Tigray region has drawn attention to the differing roles of the UAE and Saudi Arabia in the Horn of Africa. The UAE has openly declared its support for the Ethiopian federal government while advocating for peace, driven in part by its significant commercial interests in the region's trade infrastructure. Meanwhile, Saudi Arabia is being examined for its potential as a diplomatic mediator, building on its previous efforts to resolve regional disputes. Both nations remain key external players as the stability of the 2022 peace agreement becomes increasingly fragile.
amharic: በኢትዮጵያ የትግራይ ክልል ዳግም የተከሰተው ግጭት በተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬቶች እና በሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ የአፍሪካ ቀንድ የፖለቲካ ሚና ላይ ትኩረት እንዲሰጥ አድርጓል። የተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬቶች በክልሉ ካላት የንግድ ፍላጎት በመነሳት የኢትዮጵያን መንግስት በግልፅ እንደምትደግፍ ገልጻለች። በሌላ በኩል ሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ ቀደም ሲል በነበሩ የሰላም ጥረቶች መሰረት በግጭቱ ውስጥ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ሚና ሊኖራት እንደሚችል እየታየ ነው። የሁለቱ የባህረ ሰላጤ ሀገራት አቋም የ2022 የሰላም ስምምነት አደጋ ላይ በወደቀበት በአሁኑ ወቅት የክልሉን ሁኔታ ለመረዳት ወሳኝ ሆኗል።
oromo: Gonkootni naannoo Tigraayitti deebi'ee ka'e, gahee biyyoota Galaana-Garaa kanneen akka UAE fi Sa'udii Arabiyaa kan Afrikaa Gaanfa keessatti qaban irratti xiyyeeffannoo uumeera. UAE faayidaa daldalaa naannichatti qabduun walqabatee, mootummaa federaalaa Itoophiyaa akka deggeritu ifatti ibsiteetti. Gama biraatiin, Sa'udiin Arabiyaa carraaqqii nageenyaa kanaan dura taasisteen kan ka'e, akka giddu-galaatti (mediator) gahee taphachuu dandeessuun ishee tilmaama keessa galeera. Walii galtee nageenyaa bara 2022 akkuma rakkoo keessa galeen, matattii biyyoota kunneenii haala naannichaa irratti dhiibbaa guddaa qaba.

title: IRGC official warns against foreign powers interfering in Hormuz Strait
english: The head of Iran's Revolutionary Guard has issued a stern warning to international forces regarding the Strait of Hormuz. He stated that outside nations lack the authority to exert control or threaten the security of this vital waterway. According to the commander, the region must remain free from foreign dominance or intervention.
amharic: የኢራን አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ አዛዥ በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ላይ የውጭ ኃይሎች ጣልቃ እንዳይገቡ ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥተዋል። በውጭ አገር የሚገኙ ኃይሎች በዚህ ስልታዊ የባህር መስመር ላይ ምንም አይነት ቁጥጥር ወይም ስጋት የመፍጠር መብት እንደሌላቸው ተናግረዋል። በአጠቃላይ ክልሉ ከማንኛውም የውጭ ጣልቃ ገብነት ነጻ መሆን እንዳለበትም አፅንዖት ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Ajajaan waraana Eegduu Warraaqsaa Iraan, humnootiin alaa daandii bishaan Hormuz keessa akka hin seenne akeekkachiisa dabarsaniiru. Biyyoonni alaa daandii bishaan kana irratti dhiibbaa gochuuf ykn sodaa uumuuf mirga akka hin qabne ibsaniiru. Akka isaanii, naannichi dhiibbaa fi giddu-galummaa humnoota alaa irraa bilisa ta'uu qaba jedhaniiru.
